caption:
Google folded Local Service Ads into Google Ads.

Every contractor in your group chat is panicking over the new dashboard.

Here's what matters: the platform never won you the job. Follow-up speed did.

Only 17% of service businesses answer a new lead within an hour. Respond in under five minutes and you roughly double your close rate, regardless of where the lead came from.

DM SCALE
#ServiceBusiness #HomeServices #LeadGeneration #SpeedToLead #GrowthInfrastructure
rationale: Uses the real LSA-to-Google-Ads migration as a timely news hook, then pivots to Black Arrow's core position that follow-up systems, not the ad channel, decide who wins the job.
